Launch plan
The beta opens on October 21. Everything below has to be true by then, and nothing else is in
scope.
Pricing
• Team plan at $18 a seat, billed annually (Ravi and Maya agreed on Tuesday).
• Open question: seat minimums. Ravi suggests three.
• Update the pricing page before the announcement goes out.
Onboarding
Four screens, two permissions, and a moment of proof at the end. If a new person has not
seen it work on their own screen within a minute, the flow has failed.

Open loops
• Reply to Dana about invoice 4471.
· Send Jonas the benchmark doc.
